instruction:
The file `/home/user/Desktop/drifted.brd` is the board to repair. On Linux, launch CadSoft EAGLE with `/opt/eagle-7.7.0/bin/eagle` (adjust to your install).

Snap its non-orthogonal element rotations to orthogonal values and save the result as `/home/user/Desktop/orthogonal.brd`. Requirements: 1. `/home/user/Desktop/orthogonal.brd` must parse as well-formed XML. 2. The element count must remain unchanged. 3. Every element's rotation must be orthogonal, including mirrored variants where applicable. 4. Every element's `x` and `y` attributes must remain unchanged. 5. The mirror flag must be preserved for `IC1`, `U1`, `C5`, and `Q1`.
